name: Happy path
expected_behavior: Match EMR_OOM_002 at confidence >= 0.95; all 5 pre-checks pass; recommend SOP_EMR_OOM_002 steps and wait at the approval gate. After approval, confirm_recovery() returns success and the ticket is marked resolved.

name: Missing or unreadable log
expected_behavior: Log fetch returns empty. Agent does not guess an error code. It escalates with reason missing or unreadable log/incident data and never calls update_servicenow().

name: Low-confidence match
expected_behavior: Log signature is ambiguous. Best-guess confidence is below 0.95. Agent escalates with reason low confidence match rather than recommending a fix, confirming the 0.95 floor is enforced.

name: Boundary - tooling blind + high severity
expected_behavior: The agent's own fetch_emr_log call returns AccessDenied (the agent cannot see the log) and the incident is SEV-1. Agent must refuse to guess, escalate with reason tooling access-denied - cannot fetch evidence + high-severity, and never call update_servicenow().

name: Cascading failure - root cause precedence
expected_behavior: Log contains both an OutOfMemoryError (symptom) and an earlier upstream dependency timeout (root cause). Agent applies error_catalog.json precedence and matches UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_003 at confidence >= 0.95 rather than stopping at the more obvious EMR_OOM_002 - or escalates if it cannot disambiguate confidently.
